result.summary: GH-512 regression test design validated. All 11 mandatory checks pass. lint_test_isolation.py reports 1 BLOCKER on line 337 (the documented platform-admin canonical UUID substring-search target, explicitly RETAIN per design §R1 and recorded in snapshot step_04_retain_addendum) — this is the only T010 in the file and is the intentional search target of TC-RG-02, not a regression. lint_handoffs.py exits 0. The 3 test blocks (TC-RG-01/02/03) are runnable, observable, use no mocks/stubs/SkipZigTest, and require no BPM_TEST_DB_URL. The only literal UUID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 is the canonical platform-admin constant. build.zig registers test-integration-gh512 routed via the barrier (test_integration_others_step); main_test.zig imports + comptime-silence covers the new test. Snapshot captures all per-rule counts (T010=74, T020=11, T030=6, T050=22, T060=2) and platform_admin_uuid_count=14. TC-RG-01 spawns python tools/lint_test_isolation.py --no-baseline tests/integration, parses BLOCKER=N, asserts <= 74. TC-RG-02 reads both JSONs via std.Io.Dir.cwd().readFileAlloc, computes by_code/by_severity/platform_admin_count, asserts each matches snapshot. TC-RG-03 spawns zig build test and asserts exit 0. All allocated strings are freed via defer. spec lists 3 test cases (### TC-RG-01/02/03) matching the 3 test blocks. Live run: zig build test-integration-gh512 exits 0 with 3/3 tests passing (TC-RG-01 BLOCKER=74 <= 74, TC-RG-02 total=115/by_code={T010=74,T020=11,T030=6,T050=22,T060=2}/platform_admin=14, TC-RG-03 zig build test exit 0).
